content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service designed for high availability and low-latency access. It allows creators to store their digital products efficiently, making them easily accessible to customers. By leveraging R2, you eliminate reliance on traditional platforms that charge exorbitant fees. This matters because it empowers creators to operate independently, ensuring they keep more of their earnings while maintaining control over their content.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, Cloudflare R2 integrates seamlessly with other services like Cloudflare Workers for automated delivery and NOWPayments for cryptographic transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain through NOWPayments, triggering an automatic delivery of the digital product stored in R2. This architecture ensures quick access and a smooth user experience while minimizing operational overhead, allowing you to focus on creating instead of managing logistics.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Cloudflare R2 is your solution for cost-effective digital product storage.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first, sign up for Cloudflare services and set up an R2 bucket for your digital products. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers to manage incoming requests and automate delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, ensuring you accept payments without platform fees. Finally, test your setup thoroughly to ensure smooth operations before launching your store. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Edge Commerce Stack available for $197.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
NOWPayments ensures you keep 99.5% of your earnings on every sale.

Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can sell an ebook online by utilizing Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. This setup bypasses traditional payment platforms, allowing you to retain more of your earnings.

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is by using Cloudflare R2 for storage and leveraging NOWPayments for payment processing. This solution offers significant cost savings compared to platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on Gumroad or Payhip by using Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup ensures you maintain full control and receive more profit per sale.
What are the advantages of using Cloudflare R2 for digital products?

Cloudflare R2 provides cost-effective storage with low latency access, seamless integration with delivery systems, and no dependency on traditional payment platforms. This allows you to sell digital products efficiently while maximizing your revenue.
How does NOWPayments differ from traditional payment processors?
NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5% fee on transactions compared to traditional processors like Gumroad, which can charge 10%. This significant difference means more profit retained for creators.
Seamless integration means you can focus on creation, not logistics.
